task.title: Jonli sahifa: layklar, mavzu, ro‘yxat, hisoblagich
task.html:
jQuery kursi

0

Hafta rejasi

  • Selektorlarni takrorlash
  • 6-darsni o‘tish
  • IDE topshirig‘ini topshirish

Bandlar: 3

0 / 100
task.description: Sahifani jQuery yordamida jonlantiring. 1) #like-btn ga bosish #like-count dagi sonni 1 ga oshiradi (let likes = 0 o‘zgaruvchisi ishlovchidan tashqarida). 2) #theme-toggle ga bosish body dagi theme-dark klassini almashtiradi va tugmaga aria-pressed ni "true" yoki "false" qilib qo‘yadi. 3) Delegatsiya bilan o‘chirish: bitta $("#todo-list").on("click", ".item__delete", ...) ishlovchisi tugma bosilgan butun li.item bandini o‘chiradi va #items-count ga "Bandlar: 2" ni yozadi (son - nechta band qolgani). Yuklangandan keyin qo‘shilgan bandlar ham o‘chirilishi kerak. 4) #comment ga kiritilganda #comment-counter ga "12 / 100" yoziladi, belgilar 90 tadan ko‘p bo‘lsa - #comment-counter da is-warning klassi bo‘ladi. Ishlovchilar - faqat .on() orqali; .click(fn), addEventListener, onclick, innerHTML, .html() va .style dan foydalanmang.

tests.name: «Yoqdi» ga bir marta bosish → 1
tests.fail: Ishlovchida likes ni oshiring va uni #like-count ga yozing: $likeCount.text(likes);

tests.name: Uch marta bosish → 3
tests.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector("#like-btn"); b.click(); b.click(); b.click(); return document.querySelector("#like-count").textContent === "3"; })()
tests.fail: let likes = 0; ni ishlovchidan TASHQARIDA e’lon qiling, aks holda hisob har safar qaytadan boshlanadi.

tests.name: Mavzu: birinchi bosish theme-dark va aria-pressed="true" ni yoqadi
tests.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector("#theme-toggle"); b.click(); return document.body.classList.contains("theme-dark") && b.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true"; })()

tests.name: Mavzu: ikkinchi bosish o‘chiradi
tests.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector("#theme-toggle"); b.click(); b.click(); return !document.body.classList.contains("theme-dark") && b.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "false"; })()
tests.fail: addClass emas, toggleClass dan foydalaning va aria-pressed ni yangi holat bo‘yicha yozing.

tests.name: «O‘chirish» tugmasi butun bandni olib tashlaydi
tests.check: (() => { document.querySelectorAll(".item__delete")[0].click(); const texts = [...document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list .item__text")].map((s) => s.textContent); return document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list .item").length === 2 && texts[0] === "6-darsni o‘tish" && texts[1] === "IDE topshirig‘ini topshirish"; })()

tests.name: O‘chirishdan keyin: "Bandlar: 2"
tests.fail: remove() dan keyin bandlarni sanang: $list.children(".item").length - va #items-count ga yozing.

tests.name: Yuklangandan keyin qo‘shilgan band ham o‘chiriladi (delegatsiya)
tests.check:
(() => { $("#todo-list").append("
  • Yangi band
    • "); const btns = document.querySelectorAll(".item__delete"); btns[btns.length - 1].click(); return document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list .item").length === 3 && ![...document.querySelectorAll(".item__text")].some((s) => s.textContent === "Yangi band"); })()
tests.fail: #todo-list ga selektor bilan BITTA ishlovchi osing: $list.on("click", ".item__delete", function () { ... }); - shunda yangi bandlar ham ishlaydi.

tests.name: Band matniga bosish hech narsani o‘chirmaydi
tests.fail: .on() ning ikkinchi argumenti - ".item__delete" selektori: ishlovchi faqat tugmalarda ishga tushishi kerak.

tests.name: Barcha bandlar o‘chirildi: "Bandlar: 0"
tests.check: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { document.querySelector(".item__delete").click(); } return document.querySelectorAll("#todo-list .item").length === 0 && document.querySelector("#items-count").textContent === "Bandlar: 0" && __error === null; })()
tests.fail: Bandlar sonini qo‘lda kamaytirmang, har bir o‘chirishdan keyin qaytadan sanang.

tests.name: Belgilar hisoblagichi: «JavaScript» → "10 / 100"
tests.check: (() => { (() => { const c = document.querySelector("#comment"); c.value = "JavaScript"; c.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); })(); return document.querySelector("#comment-counter").textContent === "10 / 100"; })()

tests.name: Maydon tozalansa, hisoblagich "0 / 100" ga qaytadi
tests.check: (() => { (() => { const c = document.querySelector("#comment"); c.value = "Salom"; c.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); })(); (() => { const c = document.querySelector("#comment"); c.value = ""; c.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); })(); return document.querySelector("#comment-counter").textContent === "0 / 100"; })()
tests.fail: Uzunlikni har bir input hodisasida maydonning joriy qiymatidan oling.

tests.name: is-warning klassi: 95 va 98 ta belgida bor, 5 tada yo‘q
tests.check: (() => { const p = document.querySelector("#comment-counter"); (() => { const c = document.querySelector("#comment"); c.value = "a".repeat(95); c.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); })(); const a = p.classList.contains("is-warning"); (() => { const c = document.querySelector("#comment"); c.value = "a".repeat(98); c.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); })(); const b = p.classList.contains("is-warning"); (() => { const c = document.querySelector("#comment"); c.value = "a".repeat(5); c.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); })(); const c = p.classList.contains("is-warning"); return a && b && !c; })()
tests.fail: Holatni ikkinchi argument bilan bering: .toggleClass("is-warning", length > 90). Usiz klass har bir kiritishda shunchaki almashadi.

tests.name: Dastur xatolarsiz bajariladi
tests.fail: Selektorlarni va ishlovchilar ichida this.text() emas, $(this) ishlatilganini tekshiring.

hints: Layklar: tashqarida let likes = 0;, ishlovchi ichida likes++ va $likeCount.text(likes);
Delegatsiya: $list.on("click", ".item__delete", function () { ... }); - ichida this - bosilgan tugma.
Ichida $(this) kerak bo‘lsa, strelkali funksiyadan foydalanmang.

questions.question: Qaysi yozuv tugmani kurs uslubida bosishga obuna qiladi?
questions.explanation: .on() - obunaning asosiy metodi. .click(fn) va .bind() kabi qisqartmalar eskirgan.

questions.question: $(".card").on("click", function () { ... }) ishlovchisi ichida this nima bo‘ladi?
questions.explanation: this - oddiy DOM elementi. jQuery metodlarini chaqirish uchun uni o‘rang: $(this).

questions.question: Nima uchun $list.on("click", ".del", () => { $(this).closest("li").remove(); }) ishlovchisida hech narsa o‘chirilmaydi?
options: Strelkali funksiyaning o‘z this i yo‘q - $(this) tugma emas
questions.explanation: Strelkali funksiya this ni tashqaridan oladi. function () { ... } yoki event.currentTarget dan foydalaning.

questions.question: $list.on("click", ".item__delete", fn) delegatsiyasi qanday afzalliklar beradi?
options: Yuklangandan keyin qo‘shilgan bandlar uchun ham ishlaydi
Har bir tugmaga ishlovchi o‘rniga bitta ishlovchi
questions.explanation: Ishlovchi doim mavjud bo‘lgan ro‘yxatga osilgan va hodisa qaysi elementdan kelganini tekshiradi.

questions.question: Tugma ichidagi belgichaga bosilgan bo‘lsa, $("#list").on("click", ".item__delete", ...) delegatsiyasida hodisa obyekti xususiyatini uning ma’nosi bilan moslang.
questions.explanation: target - eng chuqur element, currentTarget (va this) - selektorga mos kelgan element, delegateTarget - .on() osilgan element.

questions.question: Havolaga bosish ishlovchisida event.preventDefault() nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: preventDefault brauzerning standart amalini bekor qiladi. Ko‘tarilishni stopPropagation to‘xtatadi.

questions.question: .on() orqali ulangan ishlovchini qaysi metod olib tashlaydi? Metod nomini nuqta va qavslarsiz kiriting.
questions.explanation: $el.off("click") bosish ishlovchilarini, $el.off("click.menu") esa faqat menu nomlar fazosidagilarni olib tashlaydi.

questions.question: Tugmani uch marta bossangiz, $("#ok").one("click", fn) ishlovchisi necha marta ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: .one() birinchi ishlagandan keyin o‘zi olib tashlanadigan ishlovchini ulaydi.

questions.question: Maydondagi jonli belgilar hisoblagichi uchun qaysi hodisalar mos keladi?
questions.explanation: input qiymatning har qanday o‘zgarishida (sichqoncha bilan qo‘yishda ham) ishga tushadi - bu eng yaxshi tanlov. keydown ham yozishda ishga tushadi, lekin qiymat o‘zgarishidan oldin va sichqoncha bilan qo‘yishni ushlamaydi; change - faqat maydondan chiqqandan keyin.

questions.question: $("#like-btn").trigger("click") nima qiladi?
options: Bosishni koddan ishga tushiradi, ishlovchilar ishlaydi
Hech narsa: trigger faqat formalar bilan ishlaydi
questions.explanation: .trigger() hodisani dastur orqali chaqiradi - testlar uchun va ishlovchidan qayta foydalanish uchun qulay.

questions.question: Yozuv va natijani moslang.
pairs: menu fazosining barcha ishlovchilari olib tashlandi
questions.explanation: Nomlar fazosi boshqalarnikiga tegmasdan faqat o‘z ishlovchilaringizni olib tashlash imkonini beradi.

questions.question: Ishlovchi oynani faqat Escape bilan yopishi uchun shartni to‘ldiring: if (event.key === "..."). Faqat qiymatni qo‘shtirnoqlarsiz kiriting.
